translations.web: On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed. You also went up there to offer sacrifice.
translations.bsb: On a high and lofty hill you have made your bed, and there you went up to offer sacrifices.
translations.kjv: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.
translations.asv: Upon a high and lofty mountain hast thou set thy bed; thither also wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.
